status: Research for B06/C02 review; no source approval, sign-off or contact with others
official_support: Person is keyed by accident/person and has an Accident parent; vehicle identifiers belong to an accident.
Person injury groups include uninjured people; Accident NO_PERSONS describes all people involved.
The Node description names a location key that multiple accidents can share.
The current flat resource declares WGS84 and names its projected fields VicGrid94. Node does not declare a CRS.
Current resource dates differ: Accident and the flat file are dated September, Vehicle/Person/Node August.

notes: 39 nonempty unmatched Person vehicle references persist in the complete selected live responses.
All five Vehicle count and two Person count differences persist in selected live responses.
The two local Person differences are one uninjured participant each, both in 2015.
85 missing Node cases persist in selected live responses; their Accident Node IDs are -1, -10 or -3.
All five repeated Node example groups also repeat in the live API, with identical native payload multiplicities.
All 12 selected Node/flat coordinate comparisons are numerically equal; this is not a CRS transformation.
One selected Accident has revised injury/severity fields in September while the selected Person rows remain unchanged.
Vehicle 21 is labelled Electric Device and Person 16 E-scooter Rider in the files; these codes are absent from their current dictionaries.

inferences_not_rules: Pedestrian/NA empty vehicle references plausibly represent valid non-association; explicit source nullability is missing.
The two Person count cases plausibly lack uninjured occupant detail; no rule establishing an intentional exclusion was found.
Node urban-classification variation may reflect a one-to-many export join; exact duplicate generation is unexplained.
Negative Node IDs may be unresolved-location markers; individual code meanings are not documented in the reviewed sources.
The extra trailer/electric-device records may reflect count scope or update timing; their actual cause is unknown.
Equal Node/flat numbers support investigating common coordinate lineage but do not prove the August Node datum.

search_followup.method: Official resource pages, saved/live metadata and focused web searches. Search results from unrelated datasets were not used as crash-code or CRS evidence.
search_followup.outcome: No additional crash-specific code/nullability/export/Node datum definition obtained. This does not assert that no such documentation exists.

unavailable_legacy_sources.outcome: Hostname resolution failed; PDF contents not read or adopted.
Redirect loop; legacy page contents not used.

open_questions: Which Person role/seating combinations allow empty VEHICLE_ID, including the 24 unknown-role cases?
What explains the 39 absent vehicle targets and the two missing uninjured details, or which corrected compatible release resolves them?
What are the current definitions and count rules for Vehicle 21 and Person 16, and inclusion rules for trailers/electric devices?
Which export joins generate Node observations, and what do Accident Node IDs -1/-10/-3 mean?
Which CRS/datum applies specifically to the pinned Node LATITUDE/LONGITUDE, and what lineage or coordinate operation connects it to the flat WGS84 resource?
decision: Keep the official source contract draft and bundle_confirmed false; retain all input rows and unresolved references.
